scope: Finite digit-domain research; execution and qualification are separate.

workstreams.name: Original V6 actual-output headroom
workstreams.answer: Finite private-truth headroom observed; current risk-aware superiority over strong fixed not established.

workstreams.name: Paired action-value differences
workstreams.answer: Source-cross-fit difference critic and selected-action calibration executed; no uniform conditional regret certificate or qualified replacement.

workstreams.name: Training attribution
workstreams.answer: Dynamic factor passes primary adjusted CE gate; base-risk and gate-risk main effects do not.

workstreams.name: Control cost
workstreams.answer: Original cheap gate is identical fallback; bounded wider actor fails independent quality and actual wall-time confirmation.

workstreams.name: Actual dynamic feedback
workstreams.answer: Current actual draft reaches adaptive controller. Exploratory allocation comparison positive; strong nonfeedback comparison unresolved; factorial dynamic intervention is algorithm plus feedback.

workstreams.name: Actual audio and video
workstreams.answer: Original local digit-observer, codec and clock sample gates pass; frozen external ASR recognizes only 22/64 generated versus 55/64 real input pairs. Natural intelligibility and general audio quality remain unresolved.

workstreams.name: Native model execution
workstreams.answer: Original owner actually executes qualified correctness head, generation, observation and NDU recovery. New NDU action-value production policy is not installed.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: A frozen public-state policy satisfying original CE/success noninferiority and real total-cost gates on untouched sources.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: Reject cheap replacement; retain evaluated strong controller.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: Demonstrated calibrated conditional action gains on public information, rather than private-truth realized maxima.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: Retain oracle only as a finite diagnostic upper bound.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: Real decoded speech that transfers to independently qualified observers and human perceptual evaluation on new confirmation sources, without fitting the already-open final panel.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: Retain actual codec/clock implementation and local digit results; reject a broad audio-quality or all-four-modality quality closure claim.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: NDU action-value policy ABI within native limits, calibration, independent quality/cost evidence, and real owner execution with that policy.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: Only already-qualified correctness head enters current owner chain.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: Authentic Dataset/Generator/Observer/Evaluator identities and trust material, full daemon and model-service integration, deployment-host qualification.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: authority=deny_all; no production activation or fabricated signatures.

unmet_claims_and_release_gates.needed: Joint end-to-end NDU training across all modalities, natural audio/video tasks, larger-scale generalization and cost evidence.
unmet_claims_and_release_gates.current_disposition: Bound results to small digit-domain models, recording-disjoint speech and constructed motion.
